fact.title: muscle:ls--la-find
fact.body:
### Context
The same 3-command sequence was observed 2× in this session (shadow-worker repetition detection).

### Steps
- ls -la D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma
- find D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" -o -name "*ast*" -o -name "*contract*" 2>/dev/null | head -50
- ls -la D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/core/uma-core/src/contracts/
- ls -la D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/.uma/contracts/
- find D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma -name "architecture_invariants.rs" 2>/dev/null
- ls -la D:/01_programovani/pi/plugins/pi-uma/src/

### Rule
Run the sequence as one motor chunk with `uma muscle run ls--la-find --confirm`.
